newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs downside seen limited to 135.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs downside seen limited to 135.50.

text.p: September BTP futures will continue to look negative but any downward moves will be limited on Tuesday, technical analysts said.

"On the whole we will see a moderately negative day waiting for solid support to be touched towards the end of the week followed by rebound," said Daniele Castelnuovo, analyst at Banca Euromobiliare in Milan.
"Further downward movement today will be limited in scope to 135.50 at the maximum."
At 0745 GMT, September BTP futures were at 136.20, up 30 basis points on the day.
Castelnuovo said from 135.35 there was the chance of a slight technical rebound, but he was looking for the contract to head for good support around 134.00-134.50.
"From there the contract could rebound or, failing that, the contract could slip lower towards 132.00 further out," he said.
But some analysts were less negative on BTPs.
Stavros Loizou, manager of strategic trading group at Fuji Bank in London, said the market looked as though it had now finished its impulsive downmove.
"It may range trade with a bit of an upward bias," he said adding that downside moves would present buying opportunites.
Loizou saw support for this session at around 135.80 with any upside moves likely to test resistance in the 136.60 area.
At the short end, September Eurolire futures were at 93.24, unchanged on the day.
